decision: Resolve GNOME's existing virtual keyboard seat through the stage context on Shell 51, retaining the old Clutter entrypoint only on older supported versions.
reason: Issue 63 reproduces a loader failure because GNOME 51 removed Clutter.get_default_backend. Its porting guide documents global.stage.context.get_backend as replacement.
verification: Actual bridge enable/disable under old/new/both/missing API boundaries; recent-action orientation compatibility. No alternate delivery route or keyboard owner is introduced.
not_tested: A physical GNOME 51 session is not available at decision time; its native behavior remains untested.
